mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_note (user_id, title, summary, content, cover_url, images, location, travel_date, tags, read_time, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{coverUrl}, #{images}, #{location}, #{travelDate}, #{tags}, #{readTime}, #{status})
mapper.select:
